history.content: What types of plans are offered by the IBM Cloud Internet Services?

IBM Cloud Internet Services offers several plans to choose from, including a no-cost Trial plan, Standard Next plan, and Enterprise Tier variations. The no-cost Trial plan is similar to the Standard Next plan but expires after 30 days. The Enterprise Tier plans are available with different pricing models. The features and their quotas or resource limits are compared in a table to help users choose the right plan for them.
Explain each plan that is offered by the IBM Cloud Internet Services in detail.

Sure, here's a detailed explanation of each plan offered by IBM Cloud Internet Services:
1. No-cost Trial: This plan is a 30-day trial version of the Standard Next plan. It provides 1 domain and 250 DNS records. However, after the trial period ends, it is automatically subject to reclamation. Only one trial is available per account.
2. Standard Next: This plan includes 1 domain and 250 DNS records. It is suitable for small to medium-sized businesses looking for basic security and performance features.
3. Enterprise Essentials: This plan offers 2 domains and 3500 DNS records. It is designed for businesses requiring advanced security and performance features, such as DDoS protection and HTTP/2.
4. Enterprise Advanced: This plan provides up to 1000 domains and 3500 DNS records. It is ideal for large businesses with multiple websites and applications that require comprehensive security and performance features.
5. Enterprise Premier: This plan offers customized security and performance features tailored to meet the needs of enterprise-level businesses. It supports up to 1000 domains and 3500 DNS records.
6. Enterprise Usage: This plan is available with different pricing models and offers flexible usage-based billing. It supports up to 1000 domains and 3500 DNS records.
Please note that features are pay-as-you-go, except for Trial and Standard Next plans. Also, Enterprise Tier plans offer additional features beyond what is mentioned here.

evidence.text:
The service was developed with a broad, general audience in mind. The service's base vocabulary contains many words that are used in everyday conversation. Its models provide sufficiently accurate recognition for many applications. But they can lack knowledge of specific terms that are associated with particular domains.

The language model customization interface can improve the accuracy of speech recognition for domains such as medicine, law, information technology, and others. By using language model customization, you can expand and tailor the vocabulary of a base model to include domain-specific terminology.

* There is no concept of an environment in v2. The deployment details such as size and index capacity are managed for you when you choose the appropriate service plan for your needs. For managed deployments, you can choose a Plus, Enterprise, or Premium plan, for example. For installed deployments, the sizing is managed by the deployment type that you specify when you install the service in Cloud Pak for Data.
* There is no single configuration object in v2. Control of the enrichments that are applied to documents is managed in the collections and project objects in v2. Other v1 configuration capabilities, such as the ability to customize the conversion step of ingestion, are not available in v2.

IBM Cloud

You must have the Plus, Standard, or Premium pricing plan to use language model or acoustic model customization. Users of the Lite plan cannot use the customization interface, but they can upgrade to the Plus plan to gain access to customization. For more information, see the [Pricing FAQs](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-faq-pricing).



 Language model customization 

For more information about the languages and models that support language model customization and their level of support (generally available or beta), see [Language support for customization](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-custom-support).
